text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I spent a lot of time in
the
hospital. I used to play in the
gardens and the
reception area.

text_block_list.name: Inpatient A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that you, Machan? You're back
again.

text_block_list.name: Young Machan
text_block_list.text:
Are you the lady who gave me some
candy the
other day?

text_block_list.name: Inpatient A
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you remember that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The patients were kind and would
always talk to
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The hospital is a place where life flows.
All life is
born, then it flows, and then it
goes to sea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's natural, and nothing to be afraid
of—that's
what I learned.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But in the midst of that flow, I came to
realize
something.

text_block_list.name: Inpatient Y
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that you, Machan? How lovely to
see you
again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
Are you the lady who gave me
something when I
was younger?

text_block_list.name: Inpatient Y
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, I don't think I've ever given you

anything... Was there someone here who
did?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I think so.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The people I'd spoken to, when we'd
met, and
what we'd talked about... All of
those details...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They'd go to the sea, and out of sight.
Eventually,
they would all be forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I realized... how terribly frightening
that is.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... What should I do? There has to be

something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How can I make sure I'm not forgotten?
How will
people remember me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(Memories alone aren't enough... I need

something that will last longer—much,
much
longer...)

text_block_list.name: Nurse A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, take a look at this doll I found! I
was cleaning up at
home and it gave me
such a wave of nostalgia!

text_block_list.name: Nurse B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! It's Carolyn the Carrot Fairy!
Doesn't that bring
back memories? She
was so popular back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Nurse A
text_block_list.text:
She really was! Everybody had one! I
loved the concept,
too. She was a little
clumsy, but cute all the same.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...A mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the first day of our efforts
toward
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having roped in both Vodka, a racer in
pursuit of
coolness, whose talents have
put her at the
forefront of her
generation...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And Daiwa Scarlet, an honors student
who
excels in both her races and her
studies, Aston
Machan is currently
shooting an independent film.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there, Machan the Super Spy!
You've
eluded me for the last time!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to fall into your clutches! I
must
deliver this ultra confidential data
to HQ!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Aston Machan—or, more
precisely,
"Machan the Super
Spy"—dashes off into the
wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wai—ahem—WAIIIT!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the script, this scene features Machan
the
Super Spy making a swift getaway
from her
pursuers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following Aston Machan's direction to
maximize
realism, her pursuers chase
after her with all their
might, and she
flees just as earnestly...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Until she ends up running as if she's in
a real
race!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rapidly kicking up soil as her legs go
back and
forth, she gradually picks up
more and more
speed as she hurtles
forward with her short stride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's her fast, little steps, but the
way she
runs with such single-minded
passion is both
endearing and somehow
courageous. And that's
not all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pulls farther and farther away from
her
pursuers with overwhelming speed
and immense
power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Utterly captivated, I find myself totally
forgetting
that we're in the middle of a
film shoot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Hoo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the chase goes on, her form starts to
suffer—it
seems she may be running out
of stamina.
Apparently exhausted, she
begins to slow down...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: YEAH! Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Aw... You're not supposed to catch me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chase comes to a glum conclusion as
she's
seized by her impassioned
pursuers.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I could get away... Let's
take a
break, then go again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll start from the top as soon as our
break's
over. We still have to take
photos of the
merchandise too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh? We're making merchandise for this
movie?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I can't become a super ultra mascot
without
merch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a marketing strategy that I read
about. In the
book, it said that a story is
crucial for selling
merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I came up with a plan. It's my
secret
ticket to success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan proudly begins explaining
her
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, we make a movie with a good
story. Then,
we make merchandise to go
with it. If it's a
popular movie, the merch
will sell.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then, I can take that sales data to the
URA
Planning and Production
Department and use it
to negotiate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You need a good racing record for the
URA to
make you into a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But just in case that part doesn't work
out, I'll
have strong sales as backup, so
the bigwigs will
show an interest anyway.
They're sure to...
Probably...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I think.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A journey of a thousand miles begins
with a single
step.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can see you've put a lot of
consideration into
this plan, but don't
you think it's going to be
tough to
balance all this with your racing

activities?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. It would be just as valid to
focus on
racing and wait for an offer. In
fact, that would
probably be the easier
option. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming a super ultra
mascot is a
long one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I don't start making the most of every
avenue
available to me now, I'll run out
of time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some people might say she's needlessly

rushing—and maybe they'd be right—but
perhaps
her approach shows just how
determined she is to
see things through.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to
overstep.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Get out there and do things your way,
Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glance towards Aston Machan... only to
find that
she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There she goes...
...Again?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them seem somewhat used to
this
behavior. We decide to wander
around the area
while we wait for her to
come back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that day, on the way home...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask Aston Machan about her goals for
the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her response is immediate and decisive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Triple Tiara would entail
getting wins
at the Oka Sho, the
Japanese Oaks, and the
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tour provides a grand stage on
which the
strongest runners of the
generation jostle for
peak position.
Claiming first place won't be easy.

However...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan is lovely, so she'd be right at
home on
such a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And most importantly of all... the tiara is

stunning. If I won it, I'd leave my mark
on both
the racing world and everyone's
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then it shouldn't be long before I'm

approached about becoming a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to set my sights on the Triple Tiara. No, that's why I have to.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, that settles it. I'll be counting on
your
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beneath her gentle tone lies a strong will
that I
sense would deflect any dissent.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We will. Nothing is impossible for
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our objective is now the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the battles ahead, we
start
training rigorously on a daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The independent film, however, fails
to gain
any traction at all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Thirty-four total views? They're a
tough crowd
on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road to becoming a super ultra
mascot is a
long one indeed.
